ctu1.sentence: The initiative was officially launched on 1st April 2017 under the Ministry of Textiles.

ctu2.sentence: The monthly grant is set at ₹3,000.

ctu1.sentence: Once the application is completed, it must be submitted to the nearest office of the Handicrafts Department.

ctu2.sentence: The application can also be submitted online through the official portal of the Ministry of Textiles.

ctu1.sentence: The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Textiles in collaboration with various state governments.

ctu2.sentence: As of October 2023, over 10,000 artisans have benefited from the Monthly Grant to Old Crafts Persons.
